name: ls_mab_alloc.loads
label: L1 load MAB allocations
meaning: Load miss-address-buffer allocations; request/allocation evidence, not retired-load misses.

name: l2_cache_req_stat.ls_rd_blk_c
label: L2 data-cache request misses
meaning: Core-to-L2 data-cache request misses, all types, excluding L2 prefetch. Includes more than retired demand loads.

name: ls_refills_from_sys.ls_mabresp_lcl_dram
label: Local DRAM/IO demand fills
meaning: Demand data-cache fills from DRAM or IO on this thread die. Indirect beyond-cache evidence, not a direct L3 miss count.

name: ls_dispatch.ld_dispatch
label: Load dispatches
meaning: Dispatched load operations including helper/stack work and speculative activity; not retired loads.
